name: chembl-mcp-server
description: Link compounds to protein targets, rank bioactivity, and look up drug mechanisms and indications.

CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.title: DataCanvas provider
CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.description: DataCanvas provider for the bioactivity spill and the chembl_dataframe_* SQL tools; DuckDB is the default. Set to 'none' to disable it: large bioactivity sets then inline a preview but never spill.

CHEMBL_API_BASE_URL.title: ChEMBL API base URL
CHEMBL_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the ChEMBL REST data API. Override for a private mirror or pinned host.

CHEMBL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request timeout (ms)
CHEMBL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds for an upstream ChEMBL request, capped by what is left of the call's time budget (45 s for most calls, CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS for a bioactivity spill).

CHEMBL_MAX_PAGE_SIZE.title: Max page size
CHEMBL_MAX_PAGE_SIZE.description: Rows per upstream ChEMBL page (max 1000). The bioactivity spill walks pages of this size; an inline bioactivity page requests its limit, capped at this size.

CHEMBL_DEFAULT_LIMIT.title: Default result limit
CHEMBL_DEFAULT_LIMIT.description: Default result limit applied when callers omit it.

CHEMBL_MAX_SPILL_ROWS.title: Max spill rows
CHEMBL_MAX_SPILL_ROWS.description: Ceiling on rows chembl_get_bioactivities stages to a DataCanvas table, and so on the upstream page walk behind it. Over the cap the response reports truncated: true and truncated_by: "row_cap".

CHEMBL_MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES.title: Max concurrent spill pages
CHEMBL_MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES.description: Most chembl_get_bioactivities spill-page requests in flight at once (1–6), shared by every call on the server.

CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS.title: Spill time budget (ms)
CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one chembl_get_bioactivities spill, its count and page walk (10000–600000). At expiry the rows fetched so far stage with truncated: true and truncated_by: "time_budget".

CHEMBL_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable chembl_dataframe_drop
CHEMBL_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Set to 'true' to register the opt-in chembl_dataframe_drop tool (absent from tools/list when off).

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
